description: The words of a counted offset that says its direction ('three days ago', 'hace dos semanas', 'قبل 3 أيام', '2 हफ़्ते पहले', 'ten days from today'), per pack language: dateparser's own locale data leaves some of them out (a count in words, a second word for 'ago' or 'week', Arabic's dual) and reads others where they do not count from the day said ('3 days before the meeting'). Data read by modules/memory/temporal.py (_counted); edit here, not in code. Every entry is a word or phrase matched whole and case-insensitively; a space matches any whitespace, an Arabic letter may carry a diacritic and a Hindi consonant may go without its nukta. Fields: ago_before / ago_after - the words before the count or after the unit that put it back from the day said; ahead_after - after the unit, the day said itself, which puts the count ahead of it ('from today'); ahead_lead - a word before such a count, part of the phrase ('in' ten days from today); other_before - a word just before the count that counts it from something else ('शादी से 3 दिन पहले', three days before the wedding); other_after - a word just after it that does ('3 days before the meeting', 'قبل 3 أيام من الموعد'); an ago_before word after a lone count does too ('3 Tage vor dem Termin'); numbers - a count in words, one to twelve as dateparser's own lists go (digits are read in every script); units - the words of each unit; dual - a unit word that is its own count of two ('أسبوعين'); singular - a unit word that is a count of one on its own, read so only where its clause ends ('قبل شهر.', not 'قبل شهر رمضان').
